title: Phase 6 deployment matrix result (DEPLOY-01)
description: A SIBLING of spike-result.schema.json, not a reuse. Phase 0's `binary` block is `additionalProperties: false` over a path and a file hash, and a container leg's binary is an image reference with a resolved manifest digest — the two cannot be the same sub-schema. The other differences are D-23's `not_run` (with a REQUIRED reason and all-null assertions) and `shares_filesystem_with`, the field that stops four green legs being read as four independent confirmations of a property only the container legs test.

matrix.description: The matrix identifier. `DEPLOY-01` — the requirement this artifact IS the evidence for.

reason.description: REQUIRED when status is not_run. A matrix that could not run at all is recorded with why.

expected_version.description: THE MATRIX'S OWN PINNED CONSTANT (D-21), separate from the Phase 1 tripwire value. Reusing 0.57.1 would make every leg fail by design; editing it would contaminate the tripwire that protects the Phase 0 threshold artifacts.

status.description: `not_run` is D-23's state and is NOT a weak pass. It marks a leg that never executed, which the verifier reports as a PARTIAL matrix — DEPLOY-01's checkbox does not move on the strength of it.

assertions.description: D-22's four assertions, IDENTICAL on every leg — each item genuinely differs by deployment shape, which is why these four and not others. `true` means the assertion held, `false` means it ran and did not hold, `null` means it did not run. A `null` is never read as a pass.

install_and_compatible.description: The plugin package installs and startup reports compatible — on `caido-cli` as well as the desktop app.

migrations_and_tables.description: Migrations ran and the expected table set is present in the plugin database.

artifact_and_observation.description: One proxied JavaScript response produced one artifact row and one observation row.

restart_data_presence.description: After the leg's OWN restart semantics, the data is as this shape requires. On three legs that means PRESENT; on docker-no-volume it means ABSENT with a clean start on an empty database. The boolean says the EXPECTATION held — the observed fact is `restart.data_present`, recorded separately so the two can never be conflated.

path.description: The ABSOLUTE app-bundle path. Bare `caido-cli` on PATH is a stale 0.55.3 on the recording host and is never invoked.

manifest_digest.description: The RESOLVED digest, not the moving tag. A future reader knows exactly which build ran.

data_path.description: The data directory INSIDE the image. A container-internal path, never a host path.

restart.description: The restart the leg actually performed, and what it found. `method` is asserted by the gate because a `container-restart` on the unmounted shape preserves the writable layer and would report a pass on the assertion meant to prove ABSENCE (Pitfall 8, T-06-55).

startup_clean.description: The plugin reported itself compatible on the SECOND boot with no error. On the no-volume leg this is the half of D-22's fourth assertion that says the plugin comes back clean on an EMPTY database rather than erroring.

cursorProbe.description: O-04, recorded as an OBSERVATION whichever way it lands. Nothing in the shipped design depends on the answer: the durable resume position is `last_request_id`, a re-derivable decimal integer, and `last_cursor` is an opportunistic fast path that `init()` NULLs anyway. A negative result here is not a defect.

control_query_resolved.description: THE ATTRIBUTION CONTROL, and the measurement is worthless without it. A CURSORLESS query run at the same moment as the cursored one. A cursor query failing after a restart has two possible causes and they are DIFFERENT answers to O-04: the cursor was rejected, or no query could run at all. On a guest instance the project is temporary and does not survive the restart, and with none selected every request query fails — which says nothing about cursor lifetime. Only when this is `true` is `resolved_after_restart` attributable to the cursor.

resolved_after_restart.description: O-04's answer, and ONLY meaningful when `control_query_resolved` is true. `true` means a Cursor survived a process restart; `false` means it was rejected; `null` means the cursored query was never run because the control did not resolve.

id_is_decimal_integer.description: Assumption A1. `request.getId()` returns a decimal integer string, which is what makes the `row.id.lt:N` boundary expressible as HTTPQL.

id_ordering_agrees.description: Assumption A2. Ordering by `row.id` descending agrees with `descending("req","id")`, so pages neither overlap nor skip.

reason.description: REQUIRED and non-empty when status is not_run (D-23).

binary.description: A ONE-OF discriminated on `kind`. Both branches are `additionalProperties: false`, so an object mixing a native `path` with a container `manifest_digest` matches NEITHER and is rejected.

shares_filesystem_with.description: Any other leg this one shares a filesystem with ON THE RECORDING HOST, or null. On a single machine `local-desktop` and `remote-cli` do, which is exactly the property DEPLOY-02 and DEPLOY-03 exist because of — so only the container legs genuinely test it. Required, because the overclaim this field prevents is silent when the field is merely absent.

listen.description: Loopback only, and never port 8080 — that is the operator's live desktop instance.

plugin_install_route.description: Recorded rather than left implicit, because the two routes exercise different things.

ownership_fixup.description: What was ACTUALLY done, not what the guide recommends. `chown -R 999:999` may be a no-op under Docker Desktop's uid mapping; recording the observed effect is the point.

partial.description: TRUE when any declared leg is not_run. A partial matrix is not a failed one — the phase can still complete — but DEPLOY-01 is not fully evidenced by it (D-23).

remote_filesystem_property.description: T-06-52's mitigation as a REQUIRED field: which legs actually carry the remote-filesystem property DEPLOY-02 and DEPLOY-03 exist for. Four passing legs are not four independent confirmations.
